# Cotracking analysis

Particle tracks compared with independently tracked lysosome and mitochondria tracks. Organelle tracks come from the same segmentation, density filter, Kalman linking and net-displacement filter used in `organelle_tracker_testing`; episodes and their summaries come from `batch_cotracking.py` and `summarize_cotracking_velocity.py`.

A **cotracking episode** is a run of at least 3 frames in which a particle and an organelle track have centroids within 10 px (gaps of 1 unobserved frame are bridged). Episodes are classed as co-transport (organelle moves and step directions agree), moving contact (organelle moves, directions uncorrelated) or stationary contact. Cotracking is defined by proximity and persistence only, never by velocity, so comparing velocity during and outside episodes is not circular.

Speeds in the cotracking output are in px/frame; they are converted to µm/s below with `pixel_size` and each movie's mean frame duration, so units match the rest of the notebook.

## Load cotracking data

```{r}
# folder written by batch_cotracking.py (contains movie_summary.csv and summary/)
cotrack_dir <- "./cotracking"

# per-movie mean frame duration (s) to convert px/frame -> um/s
movie_frame_duration <- time_intervals %>%
  group_by(image_name) %>%
  summarise(mean_frame_duration = mean(frame_duration, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

annotate_cotrack <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    separate(movie,
             into = c("guide", "well", "sample_id"),
             sep = "_",
             remove = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      well = as.numeric(str_remove(well, "^Well")),
      sample_id = as.numeric(str_remove(sample_id, "\\.nd2$"))
    ) %>%
    left_join(movie_frame_duration, by = c("movie" = "image_name")) %>%
    mutate(to_um_s = pixel_size / mean_frame_duration)
}

# one row per particle track x organelle type
track_speed <- read.csv(file.path(cotrack_dir, "summary", "track_speed.csv")) %>%
  annotate_cotrack() %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(mean_speed, speed_during, speed_outside), ~ .x * to_um_s),
    cotracking = factor(if_else(cotracks == 1, "Cotracking", "Never"),
                        levels = c("Never", "Cotracking")),
    # track-length bins (steps) used to match cotracking and never-cotracking tracks
    length_bin = cut(n_steps, breaks = c(1, 3, 5, 8, 12, Inf),
                     labels = c("2-3", "4-5", "6-8", "9-12", "13+"))
  )

# one row per episode
cotrack_episodes <- read.csv(file.path(cotrack_dir, "summary", "episodes_all.csv")) %>%
  annotate_cotrack() %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(particle_mean_speed, org_mean_speed), ~ .x * to_um_s),
    across(c(mean_dist, org_net_disp, particle_net_disp), ~ .x * pixel_size),
    episode_class = factor(episode_class,
                           levels = c("co_transport", "moving_contact", "stationary_contact"))
  )

# one row per particle track with both "during episode" and "outside episode" steps
cotrack_paired <- read.csv(file.path(cotrack_dir, "summary", "paired_during_vs_outside.csv")) %>%
  annotate_cotrack() %>%
  mutate(across(c(speed_during, speed_outside, delta_speed), ~ .x * to_um_s))

# particle step speed relative to episode onset
cotrack_aligned <- read.csv(file.path(cotrack_dir, "summary", "event_aligned_speed.csv")) %>%
  annotate_cotrack() %>%
  mutate(speed = speed * to_um_s)

movie_summary <- read.csv(file.path(cotrack_dir, "movie_summary.csv")) %>%
  annotate_cotrack()

cotrack_enrichment <- read.csv(file.path(cotrack_dir, "summary", "enrichment.csv"))
if (!"movie_group" %in% names(cotrack_enrichment)) cotrack_enrichment$movie_group <- "all"
```

```{r}
track_speed %>% distinct(movie) %>% nrow()
```

## Cotracking frequency

How often does a particle track cotrack with an organelle track? One value per movie.

```{r}
cotrack_rate <- track_speed %>%
  group_by(organelle, guide, well, movie) %>%
  summarise(
    n_tracks       = n(),
    n_cotracking   = sum(cotracks),
    pct_cotracking = 100 * n_cotracking / n_tracks,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# pooled counts
cotrack_rate %>%
  group_by(organelle, guide) %>%
  summarise(
    n_movies              = n(),
    movies_with_cotracking = sum(n_cotracking > 0),
    n_tracks              = sum(n_tracks),
    n_cotracking          = sum(n_cotracking),
    pct_cotracking        = 100 * n_cotracking / n_tracks,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(data = cotrack_rate,
       aes(x = guide,
           y = pct_cotracking)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = factor(well)), width = 0.2, size = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(x = "Guide RNA",
       y = "Particle tracks cotracking (%)",
       color = "Well") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = 'bold', angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = 'bold'),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = 'bold'),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = 'bold'),
    legend.title = element_text(face = 'bold'),
    legend.text = element_text(face = 'bold'),
    strip.text.x = element_text(face = 'bold')) +
  facet_wrap(~organelle, scales = "free_y")
ggsave("cotracking_rate.png", width = 5, height = 4, path = "./Output_graphs/")
```

Movies within a well are not independent, so the replicate for the test is the well (4 per guide). With 4 vs 4 wells the exact permutation test has 70 labelings, so the smallest possible two-sided p is 2/70 = 0.029.

```{r}
well_rates <- cotrack_rate %>%
  group_by(organelle, guide, well) %>%
  summarise(
    n_tracks       = sum(n_tracks),
    n_cotracking   = sum(n_cotracking),
    pct_cotracking = 100 * n_cotracking / n_tracks,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

well_rates

# exact permutation test on well-level rates; sg100 is the reference
perm_test_wells <- function(df) {
  rate    <- df$pct_cotracking
  is_ref  <- df$guide == "sg100"
  obs     <- mean(rate[is_ref]) - mean(rate[!is_ref])
  combos  <- combn(length(rate), sum(is_ref))
  perm    <- apply(combos, 2, function(idx) mean(rate[idx]) - mean(rate[-idx]))
  tibble(
    n_wells_sg100  = sum(is_ref),
    n_wells_other  = sum(!is_ref),
    diff_pct_points = obs,
    p_exact        = mean(abs(perm) >= abs(obs) - 1e-12)
  )
}

well_rates %>%
  group_by(organelle) %>%
  group_modify(~ perm_test_wells(.x))
```

### Observed vs shifted-organelle null

The null translates every organelle track in a movie by a random 40-120 px vector (same movie, same frames) and recounts episodes, so it accounts for how many organelle tracks each movie has. Pooled over movies, per guide.

```{r}

ggplot(data = filter(cotrack_enrichment, metric == "episodes"),
```

### Matched for track length

Cotracking tracks are about twice as long as never-cotracking tracks, and a track needs at least 3 contact frames to qualify, so the raw comparison is partly selection. Estimates below are cotracking minus never (µm/s), with 95% intervals from resampling whole movies:

- `raw`: all tracks
- `length_matched`: within track-length bins, pooled over movies
- `movie_and_length_matched`: within movie and track-length bin (also removes the sg100 / sg1035 imbalance)

The "outside episodes only" variant uses only the steps a cotracking track takes outside its episodes, which asks whether those particles are faster at baseline or only while cotracking.

```{r}
set.seed(1)
n_boot <- 1000

# one row per movie x length bin: counts and summed speeds for each group
cell_stats <- function(df, speed_col) {
  df %>%
    filter(is.finite(.data[[speed_col]])) %>%
    group_by(movie, length_bin, cotracking) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), s = sum(.data[[speed_col]]), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(movie, length_bin),
                names_from = cotracking,
                values_from = c(n, s),
                values_fill = 0)
}

# estimates for a given weight per row (movie multiplicity in a bootstrap draw)
att_estimates <- function(cells, mult = rep(1, nrow(cells))) {
  w <- mult
  raw <- sum(w * cells$s_Cotracking) / sum(w * cells$n_Cotracking) -
         sum(w * cells$s_Never)      / sum(w * cells$n_Never)

  pooled <- tibble(bin = cells$length_bin,
                   n1 = w * cells$n_Cotracking, n0 = w * cells$n_Never,
                   s1 = w * cells$s_Cotracking, s0 = w * cells$s_Never) %>%
    group_by(bin) %>%
    summarise(across(c(n1, n0, s1, s0), sum), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(n1 > 0, n0 > 0)
  length_matched <- sum(pooled$n1 * (pooled$s1 / pooled$n1 - pooled$s0 / pooled$n0)) /
                    sum(pooled$n1)

  ok <- cells$n_Never > 0 & cells$n_Cotracking > 0
  d_cell <- cells$s_Cotracking / cells$n_Cotracking - cells$s_Never / cells$n_Never
  movie_and_length_matched <- sum((w * cells$n_Cotracking * d_cell)[ok]) /
                              sum((w * cells$n_Cotracking)[ok])

  c(raw = raw, length_matched = length_matched,
    movie_and_length_matched = movie_and_length_matched)
}

boot_att <- function(cells, label) {
  movies <- unique(cells$movie)
  obs    <- att_estimates(cells)
  boots  <- replicate(n_boot, {
    draw   <- sample(movies, length(movies), replace = TRUE)
    counts <- tabulate(match(draw, movies), nbins = length(movies))
    att_estimates(cells, mult = counts[match(cells$movie, movies)])
  })
  tibble(
    variant   = label,
    estimator = names(obs),
    diff      = unname(obs),
    ci_lo     = unname(apply(boots, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    ci_hi     = unname(apply(boots, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
}

att_results <- bind_rows(lapply(c("lysosome", "mitochondria"), function(org) {
  d <- track_speed %>%
    filter(organelle == org) %>%
    mutate(baseline_speed = if_else(cotracks == 1, speed_outside, mean_speed))
  bind_rows(
    boot_att(cell_stats(d, "mean_speed"),     "Whole track"),
    boot_att(cell_stats(d, "baseline_speed"), "Outside episodes only")
  ) %>%
    mutate(organelle = org)
})) %>%
  mutate(estimator = factor(estimator,
                            levels = c("movie_and_length_matched", "length_matched", "raw")))

att_results

ggplot(data = att_results,
       aes(x = diff,
           y = estimator,
           color = variant)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = ci_lo, xmax = ci_hi),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Speed difference, cotracking - never (µm/s)",
       y = NULL,
       color = "Steps used") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = 'bold'),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = 'bold'),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = 'bold'),
    legend.title = element_text(face = 'bold'),
    legend.text = element_text(face = 'bold'),
    strip.text.x = element_text(face = 'bold')) +
  facet_grid(~organelle)
ggsave("cotracking_length_matched.png", width = 8, height = 3.5, path = "./Output_graphs/")
```

Same comparison within each guide (lysosomes). sg1035 has few cotracking tracks, so its interval is wide.

```{r}
att_by_guide <- bind_rows(lapply(unique(track_speed$guide), function(g) {
  d <- track_speed %>% filter(organelle == "lysosome", guide == g)
  boot_att(cell_stats(d, "mean_speed"), "Whole track") %>%
    mutate(guide = g, n_cotracking_tracks = sum(d$cotracks))
}))
```

## Velocity: during vs outside episodes

Same particle track, steps inside an episode vs steps before, between or after episodes. Each track needs at least 2 steps in each condition.

```{r}
  pivot_longer(c(speed_outside, speed_during),
               names_to = "location", values_to = "speed") %>%
  mutate(location = factor(if_else(location == "speed_during", "During", "Outside"),
                           levels = c("Outside", "During")))
```

```{r}
# per-track log2 ratio, one value per track
cotrack_ratios <- cotrack_paired %>%
  filter(speed_during > 0, speed_outside > 0) %>%
  mutate(log_ratio = log2(speed_during / speed_outside))

# by episode class (class "all" pools every episode of that track)
cotrack_ratios %>%
  group_by(organelle, episode_class, guide) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    median_log2_ratio = median(log_ratio),
    frac_slower_during = mean(log_ratio < 0),
    p_wilcox = if (n() >= 6) wilcox.test(log_ratio)$p.value else NA_real_,
    .groups = "drop"

# per well

  filter(organelle == "lysosome", episode_class == "all") %>%
  group_by(guide, well) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), median_log2 = median(log_ratio),
            frac_slower = mean(log_ratio < 0), .groups = "drop")

    x = "Episode class",
    y = "log2(During / Outside)",
    color = "Well"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),

    legend.text = element_text(face = "bold"),

  ) +

ggsave("cotracking_log_ratio_by_class.png", width = 6, height = 6, path = "./Output_graphs/")
```

During-episode speed tracks the organelle's speed, so the change depends on how fast the particle was outside. Part of the negative slope below is mechanical (the outside speed appears on both sides of the ratio), so read it as "particles adopt the organelle's speed" and not as a separate effect.

```{r}
lyso_ratios <- cotrack_ratios %>%
  filter(organelle == "lysosome", episode_class == "all")

ggplot(lyso_ratios, aes(x = speed_outside, y = log_ratio, color = guide)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Outside speed (µm/s)", y = "log2(During / Outside)", color = "Guide RNA")

summary(lm(log_ratio ~ guide + log2(speed_outside), data = lyso_ratios))
```

## Velocity: event-aligned

Particle step speed relative to the frame an episode starts (0). Episodes that begin at the first frames of a movie have no pre-onset steps, so the set of episodes contributing changes along the x axis; points with fewer than 5 steps are dropped.

```{r}
cotrack_aligned_summary <- cotrack_aligned %>%
  filter(organelle == "lysosome") %>%
  group_by(episode_class, rel_frame) %>%
  summarise(
    n          = n(),
    mean_speed = mean(speed),
    sem_speed  = sd(speed) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups    = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n >= 5)

ggplot(data = cotrack_aligned_summary,
       aes(x = rel_frame,
           y = mean_speed,
           color = episode_class)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 3) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_speed - sem_speed, ymax = mean_speed + sem_speed),
                width = 0.2) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Frame relative to cotracking onset",
       y = "Particle speed (µm/s)",
       color = "Episode class") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = 'bold'),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = 'bold'),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = 'bold'),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = 'bold'),
    legend.title = element_text(face = 'bold'),
    legend.text = element_text(face = 'bold'))
ggsave("cotracking_event_aligned.png", width = 5, height = 4, path = "./Output_graphs/")
```
